        this.splat = null;
        this.ranges = null;
        this.removed = null;
    }
}

// Bring back every static gaussian nothing references any more. Unlike undo the
// original positions are gone, so the restored instances land at the tail, clean.
class RestoreMissingInstancesOp {
    name = 'restoreMissingInstances';
    splat: Splat;
    private appended = 0;

    constructor(splat: Splat) {
        this.splat = splat;
    }

    async do() {
        this.appended = this.splat.instances.appendMissing(this.splat.resource.numRows);
        await this.splat.updateState();
    }

    async undo() {
        this.splat.instances.truncate(this.appended);
        this.appended = 0;
        await this.splat.updateState();
    }

    destroy() {
        this.splat = null;
    }
}

// op for modifying a splat transform
class EntityTransformOp {
    name = 'entityTransform';
    splat: Splat;
    oldt: Transform;
    newt: Transform;

    constructor(options: { splat: Splat, oldt: Transform, newt: Transform }) {
        this.splat = options.splat;
        this.oldt = options.oldt;
        this.newt = options.newt;
    }

    do() {
        this.splat.move(this.newt.position, this.newt.rotation, this.newt.scale);
    }

    undo() {
        this.splat.move(this.oldt.position, this.oldt.rotation, this.oldt.scale);
    }

    destroy() {
        this.splat = null;
        this.oldt = null;
        this.newt = null;
    }
}

const mat = new Mat4();

// op for modifying a subset of individual splats
class SplatsTransformOp {
    name = 'splatsTransform';

    splat: Splat;
    transform: Mat4;
    paletteMap: Map<number, number>;

    constructor(options: { splat: Splat, transform: Mat4, paletteMap: Map<number, number> }) {
        this.splat = options.splat;
        this.transform = options.transform;
        this.paletteMap = options.paletteMap;
    }

    async do() {
        const { splat, transform, paletteMap } = this;
        const { instances } = splat;
        const state = instances.flags;

        // update the selected instances' transform palette indices
        for (let i = 0; i < instances.count; ++i) {
            if (state[i] === State.selected) {
                instances.setTransformIndex(i, paletteMap.get(instances.transformIndex(i)));
            }
        }

        splat.transformPalette.alloc(paletteMap.size);

        // update transform palette
        const { transformPalette } = splat;
        this.paletteMap.forEach((newIdx, oldIdx) => {
            transformPalette.getTransform(oldIdx, mat);
            mat.mul2(transform, mat);
            transformPalette.setTransform(newIdx, mat);
        });

        await splat.updatePositions();
    }

    async undo() {
        const { splat, paletteMap } = this;
        const { instances } = splat;
        const state = instances.flags;

        // invert the palette map
        const inverseMap = new Map<number, number>();
        paletteMap.forEach((newIdx, oldIdx) => {
            inverseMap.set(newIdx, oldIdx);
        });

        // restore the original transform indices
        for (let i = 0; i < instances.count; ++i) {
            if (state[i] === State.selected) {
                instances.setTransformIndex(i, inverseMap.get(instances.transformIndex(i)));
            }
        }

        splat.transformPalette.free(paletteMap.size);

        await splat.updatePositions();
    }

    destroy() {
        this.splat = null;
        this.transform = null;
        this.paletteMap = null;
    }
}

const gradeA = createGradeTerms();
const gradeB = createGradeTerms();
const identityGrade = createGradeTerms();

// op for grading a subset of individual splats. Mirrors SplatsTransformOp: one new
// palette entry per distinct pre-edit index, so gaussians that already shared a
// grade go on sharing one, and undo is a LIFO free plus an index restore.
// A null `grade` resets the targets to the identity grade instead of composing.
class SplatsColorOp {
    name = 'splatsColor';

    splat: Splat;
    grade: GradeTerms;

    // distinct pre-edit colour indices among the targets. The new indices aren't
    // stored: the palette allocator is LIFO, so a redo's alloc hands back exactly
    // the block undo freed.
    private oldIndices: number[];
    private paletteMap: Map<number, number>;
    private scope: 'selection' | 'layer';

    constructor(options: { splat: Splat, grade: GradeTerms | null, scope?: 'selection' | 'layer' }) {
        this.splat = options.splat;
        this.grade = options.grade;
        this.scope = options.scope ?? (options.splat.instances.numSelected === 0 ? 'layer' : 'selection');

        const seen = new Set<number>();
        this.forEachTarget(i => seen.add(options.splat.instances.colorIndex(i)));
        this.oldIndices = [...seen];
    }

    // The colour panel targets the selection, and an empty selection means the
    // whole layer. Locked gaussians are never a target, which matches
    // selectedRanges(). Re-derived rather than captured because the edit history
    // is strict LIFO: any later selection change has already been undone by the
    // time this op's undo runs, so the target set is the same both ways.
    private forEachTarget(fn: (i: number) => void) {
        const { instances } = this.splat;
        const { flags } = instances;
        const all = this.scope === 'layer';
        for (let i = 0; i < instances.count; ++i) {
            const f = flags[i];
            if ((f & State.locked) === 0 && (all || (f & State.selected) !== 0)) {
                fn(i);
            }
        }
    }

    do() {
        const { splat, grade, oldIndices } = this;
        const { instances, colorPalette } = splat;

        const base = colorPalette.alloc(oldIndices.length);
        const paletteMap = new Map<number, number>();
        oldIndices.forEach((oldIdx, i) => paletteMap.set(oldIdx, base + i));
        this.paletteMap = paletteMap;

        this.forEachTarget((i) => {
            instances.setColorIndex(i, paletteMap.get(instances.colorIndex(i)));
        });

        paletteMap.forEach((newIdx, oldIdx) => {
            if (grade) {
                colorPalette.getEntry(oldIdx, gradeA);
                colorPalette.setEntry(newIdx, composeGrades(gradeA, grade, gradeB));
            } else {
                colorPalette.setEntry(newIdx, identityGrade);
            }
        });

        splat.updateColors();
    }

    undo() {
        const { splat, paletteMap } = this;
        const { instances, colorPalette } = splat;

        // invert the palette map
        const inverseMap = new Map<number, number>();
        paletteMap.forEach((newIdx, oldIdx) => {
            inverseMap.set(newIdx, oldIdx);
        });

        this.forEachTarget((i) => {
            instances.setColorIndex(i, inverseMap.get(instances.colorIndex(i)));
        });

        colorPalette.free(paletteMap.size);

        splat.updateColors();
    }

    destroy() {
        this.splat = null;
        this.grade = null;
        this.oldIndices = null;
        this.paletteMap = null;
    }
}

class PlacePivotOp {
    name = 'setPivot';
    pivot: Pivot;
    oldt: Transform;
    newt: Transform;

    constructor(options: { pivot: Pivot, oldt: Transform, newt: Transform }) {
        this.pivot = options.pivot;
        this.oldt = options.oldt;
        this.newt = options.newt;
    }

    do() {
        this.pivot.place(this.newt);
    }

    undo() {
        this.pivot.place(this.oldt);
    }
}

// op for setting a splat's user-defined local frame (the origin and rotation
// the transform gizmos and panel use in local coordinate space)
class SetLocalFrameOp {
    name = 'setLocalFrame';
    splat: Splat;
    oldOrigin: Vec3;
    oldFrame: Quat;
    newOrigin: Vec3;
    newFrame: Quat;

    constructor(options: { splat: Splat, oldOrigin: Vec3, oldFrame: Quat, newOrigin: Vec3, newFrame: Quat }) {
        this.splat = options.splat;
        this.oldOrigin = options.oldOrigin;
        this.oldFrame = options.oldFrame;
        this.newOrigin = options.newOrigin;
        this.newFrame = options.newFrame;
    }

    do() {
        this.splat.setLocalFrame(this.newOrigin, this.newFrame);
    }

    undo() {
        this.splat.setLocalFrame(this.oldOrigin, this.oldFrame);
    }

    destroy() {
        this.splat = null;
        this.oldOrigin = null;
        this.oldFrame = null;
        this.newOrigin = null;
        this.newFrame = null;
    }
}

type ShapeTransformState = {
    position: Vec3;
    rotation?: Quat;
    lens?: Vec3;        // box lengths
    radius?: number;    // sphere radius
};

// moves/rotates/resizes a box/sphere selection volume
class ShapeTransformOp {
    name = 'shapeTransform';
    shape: BoxShape | SphereShape;
    oldState: ShapeTransformState;
    newState: ShapeTransformState;

    constructor(options: { shape: BoxShape | SphereShape, oldState: ShapeTransformState, newState: ShapeTransformState }) {
        this.shape = options.shape;
        this.oldState = options.oldState;
        this.newState = options.newState;
    }

    apply(state: ShapeTransformState) {
        const { shape } = this;
        shape.pivot.setPosition(state.position);
        if (state.rotation) {
            shape.pivot.setRotation(state.rotation);
        }
        if (shape instanceof BoxShape && state.lens) {
            // the length setters refresh the bound with the new transform
            shape.lenX = state.lens.x;
            shape.lenY = state.lens.y;
            shape.lenZ = state.lens.z;
        } else if (shape instanceof SphereShape && state.radius !== undefined) {
            // the radius setter refreshes the bound with the new transform
            shape.radius = state.radius;
        } else {
            shape.moved();
        }

        // refresh the owning tool's ui. shape ops are purged from history when
        // the tool deactivates, so the shape is normally in the scene here; the
        // guard covers the brief window where an already-queued undo/redo runs
        // after a synchronous deactivate.
        shape.scene?.events.fire('shapeSelection.changed', shape);
    }

    do() {
        this.apply(this.newState);
    }

    undo() {
        this.apply(this.oldState);
    }
}

// Snapshot-based undo/redo for animation track edits.
// Captures the full track state before and after a mutation.
class AnimTrackEditOp {
    name: string;
    track: AnimTrack;
    before: unknown;
    after: unknown;

    constructor(name: string, track: AnimTrack, before: unknown, after: unknown) {
        this.name = name;
        this.track = track;
        this.before = before;
        this.after = after;
    }

    do() {
        this.track.restore(this.after);
    }

    undo() {
        this.track.restore(this.before);
    }
}

class MultiOp {
    name = 'multiOp';
    ops: EditOp[];

    constructor(ops: EditOp[]) {
        this.ops = ops;
    }

    async do() {
        for (const op of this.ops) {
            await op.do();
        }
    }

    async undo() {
        for (const op of this.ops) {
            await op.undo();
        }
    }
}

class AddSplatOp {
    name = 'addSplat';
    scene: Scene;
    splat: Splat;

    constructor(scene: Scene, splat: Splat) {
        this.scene = scene;
        this.splat = splat;
    }

    async do() {
        await this.scene.add(this.splat);
    }

    undo() {
        this.scene.remove(this.splat);
    }

    destroy() {
        this.splat.destroy();
    }
}

class SplatRenameOp {
    name = 'splatRename';
    splat: Splat;
    oldName: string;
    newName: string;

    constructor(splat: Splat, newName: string) {
        this.splat = splat;
        this.oldName = splat.name;
        this.newName = newName;
    }

    do() {
        this.splat.name = this.newName;
    }

    undo() {
        this.splat.name = this.oldName;
    }
}

export {
    EditOp,
    selectedRanges,
    SelectAllOp,
    SelectNoneOp,
    SelectInvertOp,
    SelectOp,
    HideSelectionOp,
    UnhideAllOp,
    RemoveInstancesOp,
    RestoreMissingInstancesOp,
    EntityTransformOp,
    SplatsColorOp,
    SplatsTransformOp,
    PlacePivotOp,
    SetLocalFrameOp,
    ShapeTransformOp,
    ShapeTransformState,
    AnimTrackEditOp,
    MultiOp,
    AddSplatOp,
    SplatRenameOp
};
```

### src/editor-api.ts
```
import { BoundingBox, EventHandler, Mat4, Quat, Vec3 } from 'playcanvas';

import type { CameraFrame } from './camera';
import { createGradeTerms, gradeTerms, type GradeParams } from './color-grade';
import type { CommandContext, CommandQueue } from './command-queue';
import { EditHistory } from './edit-history';
import { AddSplatOp, EditOp, EntityTransformOp, HideSelectionOp, MultiOp, RemoveInstancesOp, RestoreMissingInstancesOp, SelectAllOp, SelectInvertOp, SelectNoneOp, SelectOp, SplatRenameOp, SplatsColorOp, SplatsTransformOp, UnhideAllOp, selectedRanges } from './edit-ops';
import { checkCancelled, CommandOptions, EditScope, EditorError } from './editor-command';
import { createEditorSession } from './editor-session';
import { Element, ElementType } from './element';
import { Events } from './events';
import { Scene } from './scene';
import { rectangleOp } from './selection-rectangle';
import { Splat } from './splat';
import { isFinalColorMode, propModeFor, PROP_MODE, SH_NUM_COEFFS } from './splat-properties';
import { State } from './splat-state';
import { Transform } from './transform';

type LayerId = number;
type SelectionOp = 'replace' | 'add' | 'subtract' | 'intersect';
type InternalOp = 'set' | 'add' | 'remove' | 'intersect';
const INTERNAL_OP: Record<SelectionOp, InternalOp> = { replace: 'set', add: 'add', subtract: 'remove', intersect: 'intersect' };
const PUBLIC_OP: Record<InternalOp, SelectionOp> = { set: 'replace', add: 'add', remove: 'subtract', intersect: 'intersect' };

type LayerInfo = {
    id: LayerId; name: string; visible: boolean;
    total: number; selected: number; hidden: number; deleted: number;
    position: Vec3; rotation: Quat; scale: Vec3;
    bounds: BoundingBox | null; selectionBounds: BoundingBox | null;
    shBands: number;
};
type ScreenPoint = { x: number, y: number };
type ScreenRect = { start: ScreenPoint, end: ScreenPoint };
type DepthHit = { layer: LayerId, position: Vec3, distance: number, depth: number };
type ChangeEvent = 'documentChanged' | 'selectionChanged' | 'historyChanged';
type ChangeDetail = { layer?: LayerId };
type SelectionOptions = CommandOptions & { preview?: boolean, outside?: boolean, footprint?: number, viewToken?: string };
type RectangleOptions = CommandOptions & { layer?: LayerId, depth?: boolean, footprint?: number, viewToken?: string };
type TransformOptions = { translate?: Vec3, rotate?: Quat, scale?: number, center?: Vec3 };

// in-slot GPU intersect followed by the SelectOp it produces, in the same
// slot. Shared with the screen-space gestures in editor.ts
const intersectSelect = async (scene: Scene, ctx: CommandContext, splat: Splat, op: InternalOp, options: any, frame?: CameraFrame) => {
    // the splat may have been deleted while the task was queued
    if (!splat.scene) return;
    const data = await scene.dataProcessor.intersect(options, splat, frame);
    // SelectOp consumes `data` synchronously in its constructor
    // (IndexRanges.fromPredicate iterates immediately), so the buffer goes
    // back to the pool as soon as the op is constructed
    let selectOp: SelectOp;
    try {
        selectOp = new SelectOp(splat, op, data);
    } finally {
        scene.dataProcessor.releaseMask(data);
    }
    await ctx.apply(selectOp);
};

const SELECTION_OPS = new Set(['selectOp', 'selectAll', 'selectNone', 'selectInvert']);

const isSelectionOp = (op: EditOp): boolean => {
    if (op instanceof MultiOp) {
        return op.ops.every(isSelectionOp);
    }
    return SELECTION_OPS.has(op.name);
};

// Commands own their queue slot, including the result snapshot. The UI and
// WebMCP both use these methods; no caller should enqueue an API command inside
// another queue task. Layer IDs identify layers for this editor session only.
// Commands are async so that invalid input, missing layers and cancellation
// reject the returned promise rather than throwing at the call site; the slot
// is still reserved synchronously, before the first await.
const createEditorAPI = (events: Events, scene: Scene, editHistory: EditHistory, commandQueue: CommandQueue) => {
    const allSplats = () => scene.getElementsByType(ElementType.splat) as Splat[];
    const historyInfo = () => ({ canUndo: editHistory.canUndo(), canRedo: editHistory.canRedo() });
    const layerById = (id: LayerId): Splat => {
        const splat = allSplats().find(s => s.uid === id);
        if (!splat) throw new EditorError('layer_not_found', `No layer with id ${id}. Read the scene again.`);
        return splat;
    };
    const target = (id?: LayerId) => {
        const splat = id === undefined ? events.invoke('selection') as Splat : layerById(id);
        if (!splat) throw new EditorError('no_active_layer', 'No active layer. Specify a layer ID.');
        return splat;
    };
    const checkTarget = (splat: Splat, visible = true) => {
        if (splat.scene !== scene) throw new EditorError('layer_removed', 'The target layer was removed before the command completed.');
        if (visible && !splat.visible) throw new EditorError('layer_hidden', `Layer '${splat.name}' is hidden.`);
    };
    const layerInfo = (splat: Splat): LayerInfo => {
        const selectionBounds = splat.instances.numSelected ? new BoundingBox() : null;
        selectionBounds?.setFromTransformedAabb(splat.selectionBound, splat.worldTransform);
        return ({
            id: splat.uid,
            name: splat.name,
            visible: splat.visible,
            total: splat.instances.count,
            selected: splat.instances.numSelected,
            hidden: splat.instances.numLocked,
            deleted: splat.instances.numRemoved,
            position: splat.entity.getLocalPosition().clone(),
            rotation: splat.entity.getLocalRotation().clone(),
            scale: splat.entity.getLocalScale().clone(),
            bounds: splat.instances.count ? splat.worldBound.clone() : null,
            selectionBounds,
            shBands: splat.resource.shBands
        });
    };
    const result = (splats: Splat[], affected: number) => ({ affected, layers: splats.map(layerInfo), history: historyInfo() });
    const run = <T>(splat: Splat, fn: (ctx: CommandContext) => T | Promise<T>, options?: CommandOptions, visible = true) => {
        checkCancelled(options);
        return commandQueue.enqueue((ctx) => {
            checkCancelled(options);
            checkTarget(splat, visible);
            return fn(ctx);
        });
    };
    const applyState = async (layer: LayerId | undefined, make: (splat: Splat) => SelectAllOp | SelectNoneOp | SelectInvertOp | HideSelectionOp | RemoveInstancesOp,
        options?: CommandOptions, requireSelection = false) => {
        const splat = target(layer);
        return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
            if (requireSelection && !splat.instances.numSelected) throw new EditorError('empty_selection', 'No splats are selected.');
            const op = make(splat);
            const affected = op.ranges.count;
            if (affected) await ctx.apply(op);
            return result([splat], affected);
        }, options);
    };
    const scopeCount = (splat: Splat, scope?: EditScope) => {
        const count = scope === 'layer' ? splat.instances.count - splat.instances.numLocked : splat.instances.numSelected;
        if (scope === 'selection' && !count) throw new EditorError('empty_selection', 'No splats are selected. Use scope layer to edit the layer.');
        return scope === undefined && !count ? splat.instances.count - splat.instances.numLocked : count;
    };
    const session = createEditorSession(events, scene, commandQueue, { allSplats, layerById, layerInfo, historyInfo });
    const propertyMode = (splat: Splat, property: string) => {
        const mode = propModeFor(property);
        const rest = /^f_rest_(\d+)$/.exec(property);
        if (mode === undefined || (rest && Number(rest[1]) >= SH_NUM_COEFFS[splat.resource.shBands] * 3)) {
            throw new EditorError('unsupported_property', `Property '${property}' is not available on this layer.`);
        }
        return mode;
    };
    const propertyOptions = (splat: Splat, frame: CameraFrame) => ({
        entityMatrix: splat.worldTransform.clone(),
        viewMatrix: frame.view,
        viewProjection: new Mat4().mul2(frame.projection, frame.view),
        cameraPos: frame.position
    });
    const applyMask = async (ctx: CommandContext, splat: Splat, mask: Uint8Array, op: SelectionOp, options: SelectionOptions) => {
        try {
            checkCancelled(options);
            checkTarget(splat);
            let matched = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < splat.instances.count; i++) {
                const hit = (mask[i] === 255) !== !!options.outside;
                mask[i] = hit && (splat.instances.flags[i] & State.locked) === 0 ? 255 : 0;
                if (mask[i]) matched++;
            }
            const edit = new SelectOp(splat, INTERNAL_OP[op], mask);
            const bounds = options.preview && matched ? await scene.dataProcessor.calcMaskBound(splat, mask) : null;
            checkCancelled(options);
            checkTarget(splat);
            if (options.viewToken) session.checkView(options.viewToken);
            if (!options.preview && edit.ranges.count) await ctx.apply(edit);
            return { ...result([splat], options.preview ? 0 : edit.ranges.count), preview: !!options.preview, matched, bounds };
        } finally {
            scene.dataProcessor.releaseMask(mask);
        }
    };
    const copySelection = async (separate: boolean, layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => {
        const splat = target(layer);
        return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
            const ranges = selectedRanges(splat);
            if (!ranges.count) throw new EditorError('empty_selection', 'No splats are selected.');
            const copy = splat.createLayer(ranges, splat.name);
            await ctx.apply(separate ? new MultiOp([new RemoveInstancesOp(splat), new AddSplatOp(scene, copy)]) : new AddSplatOp(scene, copy));
            return { ...result([splat, copy], ranges.count), createdLayer: copy.uid };
        }, options);
    };
    const colorEdit = async (params: GradeParams | null, layer?: LayerId, scope?: EditScope, options?: CommandOptions) => {
        const splat = target(layer);
        if (params && !(params.whitePoint > params.blackPoint)) throw new EditorError('invalid_input', 'whitePoint must be greater than blackPoint.');
        const grade = params && gradeTerms(params, createGradeTerms());
        return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
            const affected = scopeCount(splat, scope);
            if (affected) await ctx.apply(new SplatsColorOp({ splat, grade, scope }));
            return result([splat], affected);
        }, options);
    };

    // change notifications, derived from the bus events the modules already
    // fire. Hide/unhide and visibility are classed as document changes until
    // the session/document classification pass decides otherwise
    const changes = new EventHandler();
    const changed = (event: ChangeEvent, detail: ChangeDetail = {}) => changes.fire(event, detail);

    events.on('selection.changed', (splat: Splat | null) => changed('selectionChanged', { layer: splat?.uid }));
    events.on('splat.stateChanged', (splat: Splat) => changed('selectionChanged', { layer: splat.uid }));
    events.on('edit.apply', (op: EditOp) => {
        if (!isSelectionOp(op)) changed('documentChanged', { layer: (op as any).splat?.uid });
    });
    events.on('scene.elementAdded', (element: Element) => {
        if (element.type === ElementType.splat) changed('documentChanged', { layer: element.uid });
    });
    events.on('scene.elementRemoved', (element: Element) => {
        if (element.type === ElementType.splat) changed('documentChanged', { layer: element.uid });
    });
    events.on('splat.visibility', (splat: Splat) => changed('documentChanged', { layer: splat.uid }));
    // fired once per history mutation (alongside edit.canRedo)
    events.on('edit.canUndo', () => changed('historyChanged'));


    return {
        inspect: {
            scene: (options?: CommandOptions) => commandQueue.enqueue(() => {
                checkCancelled(options);
                return { ...session.read(), layers: allSplats().map(layerInfo), activeLayer: (events.invoke('selection') as Splat | null)?.uid ?? null, history: historyInfo() };
            }),
            layer: async (id: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => await run(layerById(id), () => layerInfo(layerById(id)), options, false),
            histogram: async (id: LayerId, property: string, options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const splat = layerById(id);
                const frame = scene.camera.captureFrame();
                const viewToken = session.viewport.info().viewToken;
                return await run(splat, async () => {
                    const mode = propertyMode(splat, property);
                    const viewDependent = mode === 4 || isFinalColorMode(mode);
                    const data = await scene.dataProcessor.calcHistogram(splat, mode, propertyOptions(splat, frame));
                    checkCancelled(options);
                    if (viewDependent) session.checkView(viewToken);
                    return { layer: id, property, ...data, viewDependent, ...(viewDependent ? { viewToken } : {}) };
                }, options);
            },
            properties: (shBands = 0) => [...Object.keys(PROP_MODE), ...Array.from({ length: SH_NUM_COEFFS[shBands] * 3 }, (_, i) => `f_rest_${i}`)]
        },
        layers: {
            list: () => allSplats().map(layerInfo),
            active: () => (events.invoke('selection') as Splat | null)?.uid ?? null,
            setActive: (id: LayerId | null) => events.fire('selection', id === null ? null : layerById(id)),
            setVisible: (id: LayerId, visible: boolean) => {
                layerById(id).visible = visible;
            },
            rename: async (id: LayerId, name: string, options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const splat = layerById(id);
                return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
                    const changed = name !== splat.name;
                    if (changed) await ctx.apply(new SplatRenameOp(splat, name));
                    return result([splat], changed ? 1 : 0);
                }, options, false);
            },
            update: async (id: LayerId, changes: { name?: string, visible?: boolean, active?: boolean }, options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const splat = layerById(id);
                const values = { ...changes };
                return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
                    if (values.active && !(values.visible ?? splat.visible)) throw new EditorError('layer_hidden', 'Show the layer before activating it.');
                    let affected = 0;
                    if (values.name !== undefined && values.name !== splat.name) {
                        await ctx.apply(new SplatRenameOp(splat, values.name));
                        affected++;
                    }
                    if (values.visible !== undefined && values.visible !== splat.visible) {
                        splat.visible = values.visible;
                        affected++;
                    }
                    const active = events.invoke('selection');
                    if (values.active === true && active !== splat) {
                        events.fire('selection', splat); affected++;
                    }
                    if (values.active === false && active === splat) {
                        events.fire('selection', null); affected++;
                    }
                    return result([splat], affected);
                }, options, false);
            }
        },
        selection: {
            all: (layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => applyState(layer, s => new SelectAllOp(s), options),
            none: (layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => applyState(layer, s => new SelectNoneOp(s), options),
            invert: (layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => applyState(layer, s => new SelectInvertOp(s), options),
            byVolume: async (shape: 'sphere' | 'box', transform: Mat4, op: SelectionOp = 'replace', layer?: LayerId, options: SelectionOptions = {}) => {
                const splat = target(layer);
                const shapeTransform = transform.clone();
                const settings = { ...options };
                const footprint = settings.footprint ?? events.invoke('selection.footprint') as number;
                return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
                    const volume = { transform: shapeTransform, footprint };
                    const mask = await scene.dataProcessor.intersect(shape === 'sphere' ? { sphere: volume } : { box: volume }, splat);
                    return applyMask(ctx, splat, mask, op, settings);
                }, settings);
            },
            byProperty: async (id: LayerId, property: string, min: number, max: number, op: SelectionOp = 'replace', options: SelectionOptions = {}) => {
                const splat = layerById(id);
                const frame = scene.camera.captureFrame();
                const settings = { ...options };
                if (!Number.isFinite(min) || !Number.isFinite(max) || min > max) throw new EditorError('invalid_input', 'The property range must have finite min <= max.');
                if (settings.viewToken) session.checkView(settings.viewToken);
                return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
                    const mode = propertyMode(splat, property);
                    const mask = await scene.dataProcessor.selectByRange(splat, mode, { ...propertyOptions(splat, frame), min, max, numBins: 0, rangeStart: 0, rangeEnd: 0 });
                    return applyMask(ctx, splat, mask, op, settings);
                }, settings);
            },
            hide: (layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => applyState(layer, s => new HideSelectionOp(s), options, true),
            unhide: (options?: CommandOptions) => commandQueue.enqueue(async (ctx) => {
                checkCancelled(options);
                const splats = allSplats();
                const ops = splats.map(s => new UnhideAllOp(s)).filter(op => !op.ranges.empty);
                if (ops.length) await ctx.apply(ops.length === 1 ? ops[0] : new MultiOp(ops));
                return result(splats, ops.reduce((n, op) => n + op.ranges.count, 0));
            }),
            delete: (layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => applyState(layer, s => new RemoveInstancesOp(s), options, true),
            restoreDeleted: async (layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const splat = target(layer);
                return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
                    const before = splat.instances.count;
                    if (splat.instances.numRemoved) await ctx.apply(new RestoreMissingInstancesOp(splat));
                    return result([splat], splat.instances.count - before);
                }, options);
            },
            restore: async (id: LayerId, what: 'hidden' | 'deleted' | 'both', options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const splat = layerById(id);
                return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
                    const before = splat.instances.count;
                    const hidden = what !== 'deleted' ? splat.instances.numLocked : 0;
                    const ops: EditOp[] = [];
                    if (hidden) ops.push(new UnhideAllOp(splat));
                    if (what !== 'hidden' && splat.instances.numRemoved) ops.push(new RestoreMissingInstancesOp(splat));
                    if (ops.length) await ctx.apply(ops.length === 1 ? ops[0] : new MultiOp(ops));
                    return result([splat], hidden + splat.instances.count - before);
                }, options);
            },
            duplicate: (layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => copySelection(false, layer, options),
            separate: (layer?: LayerId, options?: CommandOptions) => copySelection(true, layer, options)
        },
        color: {
            apply: (params: GradeParams, layer?: LayerId, scope?: EditScope, options?: CommandOptions) => colorEdit(params, layer, scope, options),
            reset: (layer?: LayerId, scope?: EditScope, options?: CommandOptions) => colorEdit(null, layer, scope, options)
        },
        transform: async (id: LayerId, scope: EditScope, delta: TransformOptions, options?: CommandOptions) => {
            const splat = layerById(id);
            const translation = delta.translate?.clone() ?? new Vec3();
            const rotation = delta.rotate?.clone() ?? new Quat();
            const factor = delta.scale ?? 1;
            const center = delta.center?.clone();
            if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0) throw new EditorError('invalid_input', 'Scale must be positive.');
            return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
                const affected = scope === 'layer' ? splat.instances.count : scopeCount(splat, scope);
                if (!affected || (translation.lengthSq() === 0 && rotation.equals(Quat.IDENTITY) && factor === 1)) return result([splat], 0);
                const origin = center ?? (scope === 'selection' ? splat.worldTransform.transformPoint(splat.selectionBound.center, new Vec3()) : splat.worldBound.center.clone());
                const position = rotation.transformVector(origin.clone().mulScalar(-factor)).add(origin).add(translation);
                const matrix = new Mat4().setTRS(position, rotation, new Vec3(factor, factor, factor));
                if (scope === 'layer') {
                    const oldt = new Transform(splat.entity.getLocalPosition(), splat.entity.getLocalRotation(), splat.entity.getLocalScale());
                    const world = new Mat4().mul2(matrix, splat.worldTransform);
                    const parent = splat.entity.parent;
                    if (parent) world.mul2(new Mat4().invert(parent.getWorldTransform()), world);
                    const newt = new Transform(world.getTranslation(), new Quat().setFromMat4(world), world.getScale());
                    await ctx.apply(new EntityTransformOp({ splat, oldt, newt }));
                } else {
                    const local = new Mat4().mul2(new Mat4().invert(splat.worldTransform), matrix).mul(splat.worldTransform);
                    const paletteMap = new Map<number, number>();
                    selectedRanges(splat).forEach((i) => {
                        const index = splat.instances.transformIndex(i);
                        if (!paletteMap.has(index)) paletteMap.set(index, splat.transformPalette.size + paletteMap.size);
                    });
                    await ctx.apply(new SplatsTransformOp({ splat, transform: local, paletteMap }));
                }
                return result([splat], affected);
            }, options);
        },
        history: {
            undo: (options?: CommandOptions) => editHistory.undo(options),
            redo: (options?: CommandOptions) => editHistory.redo(false, options),
            canUndo: () => editHistory.canUndo(),
            canRedo: () => editHistory.canRedo()
        },
        viewport: {
            ...session.viewport,
            captureFrame: () => scene.camera.captureFrame(),
            pickDepth: async (points: ScreenPoint[], layers?: LayerId[], options: CommandOptions & { viewToken?: string } = {}) => {
                const frame = scene.camera.captureFrame();
                const capturedPoints = points.map(p => ({ ...p }));
                const splats = layers?.map(layerById) ?? allSplats().filter(s => s.visible);
                if (options.viewToken) session.checkView(options.viewToken);
                return await commandQueue.enqueue(async (ctx) => {
                    checkCancelled(options);
                    for (const splat of splats) checkTarget(splat);
                    if (options.viewToken) session.checkView(options.viewToken);
                    const hits = await scene.camera.pickDepths(ctx, frame, capturedPoints, splats);
                    checkCancelled(options);
                    if (options.viewToken) session.checkView(options.viewToken);
                    return hits.map(hit => (hit ? { layer: hit.splat.uid, position: hit.position, distance: hit.distance, depth: hit.depth } as DepthHit : null));
                });
            },
            selectRect: async (rect: ScreenRect, op: SelectionOp = 'replace', options: RectangleOptions = {}) => {
                const splat = target(options.layer);
                const frame = scene.camera.captureFrame();
                const captured = { start: { ...rect.start }, end: { ...rect.end } };
                const settings = { ...options };
                const depth = settings.depth ?? events.invoke('selection.useDepth') as boolean;
                const footprint = settings.footprint ?? events.invoke('selection.footprint') as number;
                if (settings.viewToken) session.checkView(settings.viewToken);
                return await run(splat, async (ctx) => {
                    if (settings.viewToken) session.checkView(settings.viewToken);
                    const edit = await rectangleOp(scene, ctx, splat, frame, captured, INTERNAL_OP[op], depth, footprint);
                    checkCancelled(settings);
                    checkTarget(splat);
                    if (settings.viewToken) session.checkView(settings.viewToken);
                    if (edit.ranges.count) await ctx.apply(edit);
                    return result([splat], edit.ranges.count);
                }, settings);
            }
        },
        files: session.files,
        on: (event: ChangeEvent, fn: (detail: ChangeDetail) => void) => {
            const handle = changes.on(event, fn);
            return () => handle.off();
        }
    };
};

type EditorAPI = ReturnType<typeof createEditorAPI>;
export { createEditorAPI, intersectSelect, PUBLIC_OP };
export type { EditorAPI, LayerId, LayerInfo, SelectionOp, ScreenPoint, ScreenRect, DepthHit, ChangeEvent, ChangeDetail, SelectionOptions, RectangleOptions };
```

class EditorError extends Error {
    constructor(readonly code: string, message: string) {
        super(message);
        this.name = 'EditorError';
    }
}

type CommandOptions = { signal?: AbortSignal };
type EditScope = 'selection' | 'layer';

const checkCancelled = (options?: CommandOptions) => {
    if (options?.signal?.aborted) {
        throw new EditorError('cancelled', 'The command was cancelled before it committed.');

### src/editor-session.ts
```
import { Color, Vec3 } from 'playcanvas';

import type { CommandQueue } from './command-queue';
import { AddSplatOp } from './edit-ops';
import type { LayerInfo } from './editor-api';
import { checkCancelled, CommandOptions, EditorError } from './editor-command';
import { Events } from './events';
import { buildExportOptions, ExportChoices, ExportType } from './export-options';
import type { FileType } from './file-handler';
import { Scene } from './scene';
import { Splat } from './splat';

type CameraSettings = {
    position?: Vec3; target?: Vec3;
    view?: 'front' | 'back' | 'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom';
    azimuth?: number; elevation?: number; distance?: number;
    fov?: number; orthographic?: boolean;
};
type ViewSettings = {
    background?: Color; showGrid?: boolean; shBands?: number; tonemapping?: string;
    showGaussians?: boolean; showCenters?: boolean; showRings?: boolean;
    selectionColor?: boolean; selectionCenters?: boolean; selectionRings?: boolean;
};
type ExportRequest = ExportChoices & {
    format: 'ply' | 'compressed-ply' | 'splat' | 'sog' | 'spz' | 'viewer-html' | 'viewer-zip';
    scope: 'selection' | 'layer' | 'visible_layers';
    layer?: number;
};
type SessionQueries = {
    allSplats(): Splat[];
    layerById(id: number): Splat;
    layerInfo(splat: Splat): LayerInfo;
    historyInfo(): { canUndo: boolean, canRedo: boolean };
};

const VIEW_ANGLES = { front: [0, 0], back: [180, 0], left: [270, 0], right: [90, 0], top: [0, -90], bottom: [0, 90] };
const VIEW_EVENTS = {
    showGrid: 'grid.setVisible',
    shBands: 'view.setBands',
    tonemapping: 'camera.setTonemapping',
    showGaussians: 'view.setGaussians',
    showCenters: 'view.setCenters',
    showRings: 'view.setRings',
    selectionColor: 'view.setSelectionColor',
    selectionCenters: 'view.setSelectionCenters',
    selectionRings: 'view.setSelectionRings'
};
const VIEW_QUERIES = {
    showGrid: 'grid.visible',
    shBands: 'view.bands',
    tonemapping: 'camera.tonemapping',
    showGaussians: 'view.gaussians',
    showCenters: 'view.centers',
    showRings: 'view.rings',
    selectionColor: 'view.selectionColor',
    selectionCenters: 'view.selectionCenters',
    selectionRings: 'view.selectionRings'
};

// Session and file operations behind EditorAPI. The transport never needs a
// Scene, Splat or Events reference.
const createEditorSession = (events: Events, scene: Scene, queue: CommandQueue, queries: SessionQueries) => {
    const { allSplats, layerById, layerInfo, historyInfo } = queries;
    let busy = 0;
    events.on('startSpinner', () => busy++);
    events.on('stopSpinner', () => {
        busy = Math.max(0, busy - 1);
    });
    events.on('progressStart', () => busy++);
    events.on('progressEnd', () => {
        busy = Math.max(0, busy - 1);
    });

    const cameraInfo = () => {
        const frame = scene.camera.captureFrame();
        const pose = events.invoke('camera.getPose');
        return {
            position: frame.position,
            target: new Vec3(pose.target.x, pose.target.y, pose.target.z),
            fov: frame.fov,
            orthographic: frame.ortho,
            azimuth: scene.camera.azim,
            elevation: -scene.camera.elevation,
            distance: scene.camera.distance
        };
    };
    const viewInfo = () => ({
        background: (events.invoke('bgClr') as Color).clone(),
        ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(VIEW_QUERIES).map(([key, name]) => [key, events.invoke(name)]))
    });
    const viewportInfo = () => {
        const frame = scene.camera.captureFrame();
        const rect = scene.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Token describes the displayed camera and coordinate system, including
        // CSS offsets. Moving panels can invalidate screen coordinates too.
        const signature = JSON.stringify([Array.from(frame.view.data), Array.from(frame.projection.data),
            rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height, frame.target.width, frame.target.height]);
        let hash = 2166136261;
        for (let i = 0; i < signature.length; i++) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ signature.charCodeAt(i), 16777619);
        return {
            viewToken: (hash >>> 0).toString(16),
            rect: { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height },
            renderSize: frame.target
        };
    };
    const checkView = (token: string) => {
        if (viewportInfo().viewToken !== token) throw new EditorError('stale_view', 'The camera or viewport changed. Inspect the scene and use its new viewToken.');
    };
    const assertIdle = () => {
        if (busy || scene.lockedRenderMode) throw new EditorError('busy', 'The editor is loading or rendering. Wait for it to finish.');
    };
    const read = () => ({
        document: { name: events.invoke('doc.name') ?? null, unsavedChanges: !!events.invoke('scene.dirty') },
        camera: cameraInfo(),
        viewport: viewportInfo(),
        view: viewInfo(),
        busy: busy > 0 || !!scene.lockedRenderMode,
        bounds: allSplats().length ? scene.bound.clone() : null
    });
    const ready = () => {
        if (scene.lockedRenderMode) return Promise.resolve(false);
        return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
            let handle: ReturnType<Events['on']> = null;
            let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> = null;
            const finish = (rendered: boolean) => {
                handle.off(); clearTimeout(timer); resolve(rendered);
            };
            handle = events.on('postrender', () => finish(true));
            timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), 3000);
            scene.forceRender = true;
        });
    };
    return {
        read,
        checkView,
        viewport: {
            assertIdle,
            ready,
            info: viewportInfo,
            setCamera: async (settings: CameraSettings, options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const s = { ...settings, position: settings.position?.clone(), target: settings.target?.clone() };
                if (!!s.position !== !!s.target) throw new EditorError('invalid_input', 'position and target must be supplied together.');
                if (s.position && (s.view || s.azimuth !== undefined || s.elevation !== undefined || s.distance !== undefined)) {
                    throw new EditorError('invalid_input', 'Use position/target or orbit parameters in one command.');
                }
                if (s.position?.equals(s.target)) throw new EditorError('invalid_input', 'Camera position and target must differ.');
                return await queue.enqueue(() => {
                    checkCancelled(options);
                    assertIdle();
                    const camera = scene.camera;
                    if (s.fov !== undefined) events.fire('camera.setFov', s.fov);
                    if (s.position) {
                        events.fire('camera.setPose', { position: s.position, target: s.target }, 0);
                    } else if (s.view || s.azimuth !== undefined || s.elevation !== undefined) {
                        const [azimuth, elevation] = s.view ? VIEW_ANGLES[s.view] : [camera.azim, camera.elevation];
                        camera.setAzimElev(s.azimuth ?? azimuth, s.elevation === undefined ? elevation : -s.elevation, 0);
                    }
                    if (s.distance !== undefined) camera.setDistance(s.distance, 0);
                    if (s.orthographic !== undefined) camera.ortho = s.orthographic;
                    camera.onUpdate(0);
                    scene.forceRender = true;
                    return { camera: cameraInfo(), viewport: viewportInfo() };
                });
            },
            focus: async (scope: 'selection' | 'layer' | 'scene', layer?: number, options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const splat = scope === 'scene' ? null : layerById(layer);
                return await queue.enqueue(() => {
                    checkCancelled(options);
                    assertIdle();
                    if (splat && splat.scene !== scene) throw new EditorError('layer_removed', 'The target layer was removed.');
                    if (!allSplats().length) throw new EditorError('empty_scene', 'There are no layers to frame.');
                    if (scope === 'selection' && !splat.instances.numSelected) throw new EditorError('empty_selection', 'No splats are selected.');
                    const bound = !splat ? scene.bound : scope === 'layer' ? splat.worldBound :
                        layerInfo(splat).selectionBounds;
                    events.fire('camera.setControlMode', 'orbit');
                    scene.camera.focus({ focalPoint: bound.center.clone(), radius: Math.max(0.01, bound.halfExtents.length()), speed: 0 });
                    scene.camera.onUpdate(0);
                    scene.forceRender = true;
                    return { camera: cameraInfo(), viewport: viewportInfo() };
                });
            },
            setView: (settings: ViewSettings, options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const s = { ...settings, background: settings.background?.clone() };
                return queue.enqueue(() => {
                    checkCancelled(options);
                    assertIdle();
                    if (s.background) events.fire('setBgClr', s.background);
                    for (const [key, name] of Object.entries(VIEW_EVENTS)) {
                        const value = s[key as keyof ViewSettings];
                        if (value !== undefined) events.fire(name, value);
                    }
                    scene.forceRender = true;
                    return { view: viewInfo() };
                });
            }
        },
        files: {
            importUrl: async (url: string, filename?: string, options?: CommandOptions & { lod?: number }) => {
                checkCancelled(options);
                assertIdle();
                let parsed: URL;
                try {
                    parsed = new URL(url);
                } catch {
                    throw new EditorError('invalid_input', 'An absolute HTTP(S) URL is required.');
                }
                if (!['https:', 'http:'].includes(parsed.protocol) || parsed.username || parsed.password) throw new EditorError('invalid_input', 'Use an HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials.');
                const name = filename ?? decodeURIComponent(parsed.pathname.split('/').pop());
                if (!/\.(?:ply|splat|sog|spz|ksplat)$/i.test(name)) throw new EditorError('unsupported_format', 'URL import supports PLY, SPLAT, SOG, SPZ and KSPLAT.');
                const loaded = await events.invoke('import', [{ url: parsed.href, filename: name }], false,
                    { ...options, throwOnError: true, attach: false }) as Splat[];
                const splat = loaded?.[0];
                if (!splat) throw new EditorError('cancelled', 'Import was cancelled.');
                try {
                    return await queue.enqueue(async (ctx) => {
                        checkCancelled(options);
                        await ctx.apply(new AddSplatOp(scene, splat));
                        splat.name = name;
                        return { affected: splat.instances.count, layers: [layerInfo(splat)], createdLayer: splat.uid, history: historyInfo() };
                    });
                } catch (error) {
                    if (!splat.scene) splat.destroy();
                    throw error;
                }
            },
            export: async (request: ExportRequest, options?: CommandOptions) => {
                const r = { ...request };
                const targets = r.scope === 'visible_layers' ? allSplats().filter(s => s.visible) : [layerById(r.layer)];
                return await queue.enqueue(async () => {
                    checkCancelled(options);
                    assertIdle();
                    if (!targets.length) throw new EditorError('empty_scene', 'There are no layers to export.');
                    for (const splat of targets) {
                        if (splat.scene !== scene) throw new EditorError('layer_removed', 'An export layer was removed.');
                        if (!splat.visible) throw new EditorError('layer_hidden', 'Show the export layer first.');
                    }
                    const count = targets.reduce((n, s) => n + (r.scope === 'selection' ? s.instances.numSelected : s.instances.count), 0);
                    if (!count) throw new EditorError(r.scope === 'selection' ? 'empty_selection' : 'empty_scene', 'There are no splats to export.');
                    const viewer = r.format.startsWith('viewer-');
                    const exportType = (viewer ? 'viewer' : r.format === 'compressed-ply' ? 'ply' : r.format) as ExportType;
                    const fileType = (viewer ? r.format === 'viewer-html' ? 'htmlViewer' : 'packageViewer' :
                        r.format === 'compressed-ply' ? 'compressedPly' : r.format) as FileType;
                    const background = events.invoke('bgClr') as Color;
                    const choices = {
                        ...r,
                        compressedPly: r.format === 'compressed-ply',
                        viewerType: r.format === 'viewer-html' ? 'html' as const : 'zip' as const,
                        fov: scene.camera.fov,
                        backgroundColor: [background.r, background.g, background.b] as [number, number, number]
                    };
                    const settings = buildExportOptions(events, exportType, choices);
                    settings.serializeSettings.selected = r.scope === 'selection';
                    await events.invoke('scene.write', fileType, settings, undefined, { ...options, throwOnError: true, splats: targets });
                    return { filename: r.filename, format: r.format, layers: targets.map(s => s.uid), splats: count, status: 'download_requested' };
                });
            }
        }
    };
};

export { createEditorSession };
export type { CameraSettings, ViewSettings, ExportRequest };
```

### src/editor-splat-resource.ts
```
import {
    ChunkData,
    ChunkDataPool,
    ChunkField,
    ChunkLayer,
    ChunkSource,
    SHBands,
    createChunkDataPool,
    sortMortonInterleaved
} from '@playcanvas/splat-transform';
import {
    PIXELFORMAT_R32U,
    PIXELFORMAT_RGBA16F,
    PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32U,
    BoundingBox,
    FloatPacking,
    GraphicsDevice,
    GSplatContainer,
    GSplatFormat,
    Quat,
    Vec3
} from 'playcanvas';

import { type BlobReadSource, PermutedChunkSource } from './io';

const SH_REST_COUNTS = [0, 9, 24, 45];

// Stages of EditorSplatResource.upload after the read sweep. Both block the
// main thread, so the UI is given a frame to paint the announcement first.
type UploadPhase = 'sort' | 'upload';

// Yield to the event loop so pending DOM changes can be painted before a long
// synchronous stage. A macrotask, not requestAnimationFrame: rAF never fires
// in a hidden tab, which would stall the load until the tab is shown again.
const yieldToPaint = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(resolve, 0);
});

// One SH texture filled by the upload sweep: which packed coefficient words it
// stores and its per-row component count.
type SHTarget = {
    packed: Uint32Array;
    firstCoeff: number;
    coeffCount: number;
    components: number;
};

const chunkCount = (source: ChunkSource, chunkIndex: number) => {
    return Math.min(source.meta.chunkSize, source.meta.numGaussians - chunkIndex * source.meta.chunkSize);
};

const acquire = (pool: ChunkDataPool, source: ChunkSource, layer: ChunkLayer, count: number) => {
    return pool.acquire(layer, source.meta.layouts[layer], count);
};

class EditorSplatResource extends GSplatContainer {
    // the lazily-read static data. replaced only by rebind()
    source: ChunkSource;
    // the local files `source` lazily reads through, when it was loaded from
    // any. These must not be overwritten while in use (see scene.sourcesOf).
    fileSources: BlobReadSource[] = [];
    readonly sourcePool: ChunkDataPool;
    readonly shBands: SHBands;
    // the state column as loaded from file. read-only after upload: the live
    // editor state belongs to the instance list, not to the static resource
    readonly initialState: Uint8Array;
    readonly propertyNames: ReadonlySet<string>;

    // number of layers (Splats) referencing this static data. Layers can share a
    // resource - duplicate and separate create a new layer over the same
    // gaussians rather than copying them - so the asset behind it must outlive
    // any single layer. Deliberately not the engine's inherited `refCount`: that
    // one means "in use by the sorter this frame" and is drained by
    // GSplatDirector, which the editor's custom renderer replaced, so a
    // deferred destroy queued there would never be processed.
    private layerRefs = 0;

    private closed = false;

    private constructor(device: GraphicsDevice, source: ChunkSource) {
        const { shBands } = source.meta;
        const streams: { name: string, format: number }[] = [
            { name: 'splatColor', format: PIXELFORMAT_RGBA16F },
            { name: 'transformA', format: PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32U },
            { name: 'transformB', format: PIXELFORMAT_RGBA16F }
        ];
        if (shBands > 0) {
            streams.push({ name: 'splatSH_1to3', format: PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32U });
            if (shBands > 1) {
                streams.push({ name: 'splatSH_4to7', format: PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32U });
                streams.push({ name: 'splatSH_8to11', format: shBands > 2 ? PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32U : PIXELFORMAT_R32U });
                if (shBands > 2) {
                    streams.push({ name: 'splatSH_12to15', format: PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32U });
                }
            }
        }

        const format = new GSplatFormat(device, streams, {
            readWGSL: '#include "gsplatUncompressedVS"'
        });
        super(device, source.meta.numGaussians, format);

        this.source = source;
        const pooledBytes = Object.values(source.meta.layouts).reduce((sum, layout) => sum + layout.stride * source.meta.chunkSize, 0);
        this.sourcePool = createChunkDataPool({
            chunkSize: source.meta.chunkSize,
            maxPooledBytes: pooledBytes
        });
        this.shBands = shBands;
        this.initialState = new Uint8Array(source.meta.numGaussians);

        const properties = new Set([
            'x', 'y', 'z',
            'scale_0', 'scale_1', 'scale_2',
            'rot_0', 'rot_1', 'rot_2', 'rot_3',
            'f_dc_0', 'f_dc_1', 'f_dc_2', 'opacity'
        ]);
        for (let i = 0; i < SH_REST_COUNTS[shBands]; ++i) {
            properties.add(`f_rest_${i}`);
        }
        source.meta.extraColumns.forEach(column => properties.add(column.name));
        properties.add('state');
        properties.add('transform');
        this.propertyNames = properties;
    }

    // rows of static gaussian data. named apart from the live instance count on
    // Splat so the two iteration domains can't be confused
    get numRows() {
        return this.numSplats;
    }

    // `reorder` Morton-orders the gaussians during upload (see loadSplatSource's
    // `reorder`); the resource then reads through a PermutedChunkSource over
    // `source` so rows and texels agree. `onPhase` is told when the read sweep
    // is over and the remaining (synchronous) stages begin, for progress UI.
    static async create(device: GraphicsDevice, source: ChunkSource, reorder = false, onPhase?: (phase: UploadPhase) => void) {
        const resource = new EditorSplatResource(device, source);
        try {
            await resource.upload(reorder, onPhase);
            return resource;
        } catch (err) {
            await resource.close();
            resource.destroy();
            throw err;
        }
    }

    private async forEachChunk(
        source: ChunkSource,
        layers: ChunkLayer[],
        callback: (base: number, count: number, data: Partial<Record<ChunkLayer, ChunkData>>) => void
    ) {
        const { sourcePool } = this;
        for (let chunkIndex = 0; chunkIndex < source.meta.numChunks[0]; ++chunkIndex) {
            const count = chunkCount(source, chunkIndex);
            const chunks: Partial<Record<ChunkLayer, ChunkData>> = {};
            for (const layer of layers) {
                chunks[layer] = acquire(sourcePool, source, layer, count);
            }
            try {
                await source.read({ chunkIndex, ...chunks });
                callback(chunkIndex * source.meta.chunkSize, count, chunks);
            } finally {
                Object.values(chunks).forEach(chunk => chunk.release());
            }
        }
    }

    private fillTransformA(packed: Uint32Array, position: Float32Array, geometric: Float32Array, base: number, count: number) {
        const floats = new Float32Array(packed.buffer);
        const quat = new Quat();
        for (let i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            const dst = (base + i) * 4;
            const pos = i * 3;
            const geo = i * 8;
            quat.set(geometric[geo + 1], geometric[geo + 2], geometric[geo + 3], geometric[geo]).normalize();
            if (quat.w < 0) quat.mulScalar(-1);
            floats[dst] = position[pos];
            floats[dst + 1] = position[pos + 1];
            floats[dst + 2] = position[pos + 2];
            packed[dst + 3] = FloatPacking.float2Half(quat.x) | (FloatPacking.float2Half(quat.y) << 16);
        }
    }

    private fillTransformB(packed: Uint16Array, geometric: Float32Array, base: number, count: number) {
        const quat = new Quat();
        for (let i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            const dst = (base + i) * 4;
            const geo = i * 8;
            quat.set(geometric[geo + 1], geometric[geo + 2], geometric[geo + 3], geometric[geo]).normalize();
            if (quat.w < 0) quat.mulScalar(-1);
            packed[dst] = FloatPacking.float2Half(Math.exp(geometric[geo + 4]));
            packed[dst + 1] = FloatPacking.float2Half(Math.exp(geometric[geo + 5]));
            packed[dst + 2] = FloatPacking.float2Half(Math.exp(geometric[geo + 6]));
            packed[dst + 3] = FloatPacking.float2Half(quat.z);
        }
    }

    private fillColor(packed: Uint16Array, geometric: Float32Array, color: Float32Array, colorStride: number, base: number, count: number) {
        const SH_C0 = 0.28209479177387814;
        for (let i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            const dst = (base + i) * 4;
            const col = i * colorStride;
            packed[dst] = FloatPacking.float2Half(color[col] * SH_C0 + 0.5);
            packed[dst + 1] = FloatPacking.float2Half(color[col + 1] * SH_C0 + 0.5);
            packed[dst + 2] = FloatPacking.float2Half(color[col + 2] * SH_C0 + 0.5);
            packed[dst + 3] = FloatPacking.float2Half(1 / (1 + Math.exp(-geometric[i * 8 + 7])));
        }
    }

    // Quantize each row's SH coefficients once (11/10/11-bit triples against
    // the row's max, whose float bits are stored as coefficient word 0) and
    // write all SH textures from the shared result.
    private fillSH(targets: SHTarget[], color: Float32Array, colorStride: number, base: number, count: number) {
        const numCoeffs = SH_REST_COUNTS[this.shBands] / 3;
        const t11 = (1 << 11) - 1;
        const t10 = (1 << 10) - 1;
        const value = new Float32Array(1);
        const bits = new Uint32Array(value.buffer);
        const coeffs = new Array(numCoeffs * 3).fill(0);

        for (let i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            const col = i * colorStride + 3;
            for (let j = 0; j < numCoeffs; ++j) {
                coeffs[j * 3] = color[col + j];
                coeffs[j * 3 + 1] = color[col + numCoeffs + j];
                coeffs[j * 3 + 2] = color[col + numCoeffs * 2 + j];
            }
            let max = Math.abs(coeffs[0]);
            for (let j = 1; j < coeffs.length; ++j) max = Math.max(max, Math.abs(coeffs[j]));
            if (max === 0) continue;
            for (let j = 0; j < coeffs.length; j += 3) {
                coeffs[j] = Math.max(0, Math.min(t11, Math.floor((coeffs[j] / max * 0.5 + 0.5) * t11 + 0.5)));
                coeffs[j + 1] = Math.max(0, Math.min(t10, Math.floor((coeffs[j + 1] / max * 0.5 + 0.5) * t10 + 0.5)));
                coeffs[j + 2] = Math.max(0, Math.min(t11, Math.floor((coeffs[j + 2] / max * 0.5 + 0.5) * t11 + 0.5)));
            }
            value[0] = max;
            const row = base + i;
            for (const target of targets) {
                const dst = row * target.components;
                for (let c = 0; c < target.coeffCount; ++c) {
                    const coeff = target.firstCoeff + c;
                    if (coeff === 0) {
                        target.packed[dst] = bits[0];
                    } else {
                        const o = (coeff - 1) * 3;
                        target.packed[dst + c] = coeffs[o] << 21 | coeffs[o + 1] << 11 | coeffs[o + 2];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fillState(stateField: ChunkField, other: ChunkData, base: number, count: number) {
        const data = new DataView(other.data);
        const stride = other.stride;
        for (let i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            const offset = i * stride + stateField.byteOffset;
            const value = stateField.type === 'uint32' ? data.getUint32(offset, true) : data.getFloat32(offset, true);
            this.initialState[base + i] = value;
        }
    }

    // Reorder rows of `components` elements each: the row at `i` before the
    // call moves to row `inverse[i]`. Written as a scatter (sequential read,
    // random write) rather than a gather: random writes retire through the
    // store buffer while random reads stall, and at ~23M rows the gather form
    // measured ~1 s against a fraction of that for the scatter. `slice()` is a
    // sequential copy, so peak extra memory is one texture at a time.
    private static permuteRows(data: Uint8Array | Uint16Array | Uint32Array, components: number, inverse: Uint32Array) {
        const src = data.slice();
        const n = inverse.length;
        if (components === 4) {
            for (let i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                const s = i * 4;
                const d = inverse[i] * 4;
                data[d] = src[s];
                data[d + 1] = src[s + 1];
                data[d + 2] = src[s + 2];
                data[d + 3] = src[s + 3];
            }
        } else {
            for (let i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                const s = i * components;
                const d = inverse[i] * components;
                for (let c = 0; c < components; ++c) {
                    data[d + c] = src[s + c];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private async upload(reorder: boolean, onPhase?: (phase: UploadPhase) => void) {
        const { source, shBands } = this;
        const numRows = source.meta.numGaussians;

        const shDefs: { name: string, firstCoeff: number, coeffCount: number, components: number }[] = [];
        if (shBands > 0) {
            shDefs.push({ name: 'splatSH_1to3', firstCoeff: 0, coeffCount: 4, components: 4 });
            if (shBands > 1) {
                shDefs.push({ name: 'splatSH_4to7', firstCoeff: 4, coeffCount: 4, components: 4 });
                const wide = shBands > 2;
                shDefs.push({ name: 'splatSH_8to11', firstCoeff: 8, coeffCount: wide ? 4 : 1, components: wide ? 4 : 1 });
                if (wide) {
                    shDefs.push({ name: 'splatSH_12to15', firstCoeff: 12, coeffCount: 4, components: 4 });
                }
            }
        }

        const textureNames = ['transformA', 'transformB', 'splatColor', ...shDefs.map(sh => sh.name)];
        const textures = textureNames.map(name => this.getTexture(name));
        const targets = textures.map((texture) => {
            texture.releaseSourceAfterUpload = true;
            return texture.lock() as Uint16Array | Uint32Array;
        });
        const shTargets: SHTarget[] = shDefs.map((sh, i) => ({ ...sh, packed: targets[3 + i] as Uint32Array }));

        const stateField = source.meta.availableLayers.has('other') ? source.meta.layouts.other?.fields.state : undefined;
        const layers: ChunkLayer[] = ['position', 'geometric', 'color'];
        if (stateField) layers.push('other');

        const colorStride = 3 + SH_REST_COUNTS[shBands];
        const min = new Vec3(Infinity, Infinity, Infinity);
        const max = new Vec3(-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity);

        try {
            // Single sequential sweep in file order: read each chunk once and
            // fill all textures, the state array and the source AABB from it.
            await this.forEachChunk(source, layers, (base, count, chunks) => {
                const position = new Float32Array(chunks.position.data, 0, count * 3);
                const geometric = new Float32Array(chunks.geometric.data, 0, count * 8);
                const color = new Float32Array(chunks.color.data, 0, count * colorStride);

                this.fillTransformA(targets[0] as Uint32Array, position, geometric, base, count);
                this.fillTransformB(targets[1] as Uint16Array, geometric, base, count);
                this.fillColor(targets[2] as Uint16Array, geometric, color, colorStride, base, count);
                if (shTargets.length > 0) {
                    this.fillSH(shTargets, color, colorStride, base, count);
                }
                if (stateField) {
                    this.fillState(stateField, chunks.other, base, count);
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                    const o = i * 3;
                    min.x = Math.min(min.x, position[o]);
                    min.y = Math.min(min.y, position[o + 1]);
                    min.z = Math.min(min.z, position[o + 2]);
                    max.x = Math.max(max.x, position[o]);
                    max.y = Math.max(max.y, position[o + 1]);
                    max.z = Math.max(max.z, position[o + 2]);
                }
            });

            if (reorder) {
                if (onPhase) {
                    onPhase('sort');
                    await yieldToPaint();
                }

                // Morton ordering needs every position before any row can be
                // placed, so rather than a separate positions pass over the
                // file, sort from the positions the sweep has already written:
                // transformA rows are [x, y, z, packed quat] as 32-bit words,
                // so a float view at stride 4 is the sort's input as-is (the
                // fourth word is never read). Then permute the filled textures.
                // order[i] is the file row that lands at texel/row i
                const transformA = targets[0];
                const positions = new Float32Array(transformA.buffer, transformA.byteOffset, numRows * 4);
                const order = new Uint32Array(numRows);
                for (let i = 0; i < numRows; ++i) order[i] = i;
                sortMortonInterleaved(positions, order, 4);

                // inverse[fileRow] is the texel/row it moves to
                const inverse = new Uint32Array(numRows);
                for (let i = 0; i < numRows; ++i) inverse[order[i]] = i;

                const components = [4, 4, 4, ...shDefs.map(sh => sh.components)];
                targets.forEach((target, i) => EditorSplatResource.permuteRows(target, components[i], inverse));
                EditorSplatResource.permuteRows(this.initialState, 1, inverse);
                this.source = new PermutedChunkSource(source, order);
            }
        } catch (err) {
            textures.forEach(texture => texture.unlock());
            throw err;
        }

        if (onPhase) {
            onPhase('upload');
            await yieldToPaint();
        }

        textures.forEach((texture) => {
            texture.unlock();
            texture.upload();
            // Texture.releaseSourceAfterUpload currently only releases ImageBitmap
            // sources. These immutable typed-array levels can be discarded after
            // the synchronous WebGPU upload; the retained ChunkSource is the
            // authoritative CPU-side copy.
            const levels = (texture as any)._levels;
            if (levels) levels[0] = null;
        });

        this.aabb = new BoundingBox();
        this.aabb.setMinMax(min, max);

        this.sourcePool.trim(0);
        this.update(numRows, false);
    }

    // register a layer's interest in this static data
    acquire() {
        this.layerRefs++;
    }

    // release a layer's interest. Returns true when the caller released the last
    // one and is therefore responsible for unloading the asset.
    release() {
        this.layerRefs--;
        return this.layerRefs <= 0;
    }

    // Read from `source` instead: an identical view of the same rows, in the
    // same order, from elsewhere. Used after the document is saved over the file
    // this resource was loaded from, when the freshly written archive replaces
    // the now-invalid original (see doc.ts). The GPU data is untouched.
    async rebind(source: ChunkSource) {
        if (source.meta.numGaussians !== this.numRows) {
            throw new Error(`Cannot rebind resource: expected ${this.numRows} rows, got ${source.meta.numGaussians}`);
        }
        const previous = this.source;
        this.source = source;
        await previous.close();
    }

    async close() {
        if (this.closed) return;
        this.closed = true;
        this.sourcePool.destroy();
        await this.source.close();
    }

    protected _actualDestroy() {
        this.close().catch(console.error);
        super._actualDestroy();
    }
}

export { EditorSplatResource };
```

### src/editor.ts
```
import { Color, Mat4, Quat, Texture, Vec3 } from 'playcanvas';

import type { CameraFrame } from './camera';
import type { GradeParams } from './color-grade';
import type { CommandContext } from './command-queue';
import { EditHistory } from './edit-history';
import { SelectOp, MultiOp, SetLocalFrameOp } from './edit-ops';
import { intersectSelect, PUBLIC_OP, type EditorAPI } from './editor-api';
import { EditorError } from './editor-command';
import { Element, ElementType } from './element';
import { Events } from './events';
import type { GridPlane } from './infinite-grid';
import { Scene } from './scene';
import { runSelectionGesture } from './selection-gesture';
import { packRegion, emptyRegion, rectRegion } from './selection-rectangle';
import { Splat } from './splat';

// register for editor and scene events
const registerEditorEvents = (events: Events, editHistory: EditHistory, scene: Scene, api: EditorAPI) => {
    const vec = new Vec3();
    const vec2 = new Vec3();

    // get the list of selected splats (currently limited to just a single one)
    const selectedSplats = () => {
        const selected = events.invoke('selection') as Splat;
        return selected?.visible ? [selected] : [];
    };

    let lastExportCursor = 0;

    // add unsaved changes warning message.
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', (e) => {
        if (!events.invoke('scene.dirty')) {
            // if the undo cursor matches last export, then we have no unsaved changes
            return undefined;
        }

        const msg = 'You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave?';
        e.returnValue = msg;
        return msg;
    });

    events.function('targetSize', () => {
        return scene.targetSize;
    });

    events.on('scene.clear', () => {
        scene.clear();
        editHistory.clear();
        lastExportCursor = 0;
    });

    // When a splat is destroyed, drop the edit operations that reference it: they
    // can never be replayed. Deliberately keyed on destruction rather than on
    // removal from the scene - undoing an AddSplatOp (duplicate / separate) also
    // removes the layer, and pruning there would delete the very op redo needs.
    events.on('scene.elementDestroyed', (element: Element) => {
        if (element.type === ElementType.splat) {
            editHistory.removeForSplat(element as Splat);
        }
    });

    events.function('scene.dirty', () => {
        return editHistory.cursor !== lastExportCursor;
    });

    events.on('doc.saved', () => {
        lastExportCursor = editHistory.cursor;
    });

    // force render on some events

    [
        'view.centerSize', 'view.outlineSelection', 'view.gaussians', 'view.centers', 'view.rings',
        'view.ringSize', 'view.editView',
        'view.selectionColor', 'view.selectionCenters', 'view.selectionRings',
        'view.splatsColorBlend', 'view.splatsSelectionBlend',
        'view.centersColorBlend', 'view.centersSelectionBlend',
        'view.ringsColorBlend', 'view.ringsSelectionBlend',
        'view.bands', 'view.minPixelSize', 'view.stochastic', 'view.sortMode', 'view.perfOverlay', 'view.overdraw', 'camera.bound', 'camera.boundDimensions', 'camera.showPoses',
        'camera.showInfo', 'selection.changed', 'tool.coordSpace', 'colorPanel.pendingChanged'
    ].forEach((eventName) => {
        events.on(eventName, () => {
            scene.forceRender = true;
        });
    });

    // grid.visible

    const setGridVisible = (visible: boolean) => {
        if (visible !== scene.grid.visible) {
            scene.grid.visible = visible;
            events.fire('grid.visible', visible);
        }
    };

    events.function('grid.visible', () => {
        return scene.grid.visible;
    });

    events.on('grid.setVisible', (visible: boolean) => {
        setGridVisible(visible);
    });

    events.on('grid.toggleVisible', () => {
        setGridVisible(!scene.grid.visible);
    });

    setGridVisible(scene.config.show.grid);

    // grid.planes: the set of planes drawn, in xz, xy, yz order

    const planeOrder: GridPlane[] = ['xz', 'xy', 'yz'];

    const setGridPlanes = (planes: GridPlane[]) => {
        const next = planeOrder.filter(plane => planes.includes(plane));
        if (next.join() !== scene.grid.planes.join()) {
            scene.grid.planes = next;
            events.fire('grid.planes', next.slice());
        }
    };

    events.function('grid.planes', () => {
        return scene.grid.planes.slice();
    });

    events.on('grid.setPlanes', (planes: GridPlane[]) => {
        setGridPlanes(planes);
    });

    events.on('grid.togglePlane', (plane: GridPlane) => {
        const planes = scene.grid.planes;
        setGridPlanes(planes.includes(plane) ? planes.filter(p => p !== plane) : [...planes, plane]);
    });

    // camera.fovDolly

    let fovDolly = false;

    const setFovDolly = (value: boolean) => {
        if (value !== fovDolly) {
            fovDolly = value;
            events.fire('camera.fovDolly', fovDolly);
        }
    };

    events.function('camera.fovDolly', () => {
        return fovDolly;
    });

    events.on('camera.setFovDolly', (value: boolean) => {
        setFovDolly(value);
    });

    // camera.fov

    const setCameraFov = (fov: number) => {
        const { camera } = scene;
        if (fov !== camera.fov) {
            const oldFovFactor = camera.fovFactor;
            camera.fov = fov;

            // by default a fov change acts like a lens zoom: scale distance so
            // the camera's world-space offset from the focal point (distance *
            // sceneRadius / fovFactor) is unchanged. with auto-dolly enabled
            // the camera moves instead, preserving the subject's framing.
            if (!fovDolly) {
                const { controls } = scene.config;
                const k = camera.fovFactor / oldFovFactor;
                const t = camera.distanceTween;
                for (const s of [t.value, t.source, t.target]) {
                    s.distance = Math.max(controls.minZoom, Math.min(controls.maxZoom, s.distance * k));
                }
            }

            events.fire('camera.fov', camera.fov);
        }
    };

    events.function('camera.fov', () => {
        return scene.camera.fov;
    });

    events.on('camera.setFov', (fov: number) => {
        setCameraFov(fov);
    });

    // camera.tonemapping

    events.function('camera.tonemapping', () => {
        return scene.camera.tonemapping;
    });

    events.on('camera.setTonemapping', (value: string) => {
        scene.camera.tonemapping = value;
    });

    // camera.bound

    let bound = scene.config.show.bound;

    const setBoundVisible = (visible: boolean) => {
        if (visible !== bound) {
            bound = visible;
